Static Plotting Examples¶

This notebook demonstrates the usage of adataviz static plotting functions:

  • plot_categorical – UMAP colored by categorical annotations

  • plot_gene – UMAP colored by gene expression + violin plot

  • stacked_barplot – cell type composition across groups

[1]:

import os
import sys

sys.path.append(os.path.expanduser("~/Projects/Github/adataviz"))
import adataviz as av
import anndata

# Apply publication-quality matplotlib defaults.
av.pl.use_scientific_style()

[2]:

# Path to the example AnnData file
adata_path = "~/Projects/BICAN/adata/HMBA_v2/HMBA.Group.downsample_1500.h5ad"

# Quick look at the data
adata = anndata.read_h5ad(os.path.expanduser(adata_path), backed="r")
print(f"Shape: {adata.shape}")
print(
    f"Categorical columns: Neighborhood ({adata.obs['Neighborhood'].nunique()}), "
    f"Class ({adata.obs['Class'].nunique()}), "
    f"Subclass ({adata.obs['Subclass'].nunique()}), "
    f"Group ({adata.obs['Group'].nunique()})"
)
print(f"Embeddings: {list(adata.obsm.keys())}")
adata.file.close()

1. plot_categorical – Categorical UMAP (or TSNE)¶

Plot a UMAP embedding colored by a categorical variable (e.g. Class), with labeled cluster centroids.

[3]:

# Basic usage: color by Class with text annotation
ax = av.pl.plot_categorical(
    adata=adata_path,
    basis="umap",
    groupby="Class",
    coding=False,
    text_anno="Class",
    # save="Class.umap.no_text.pdf",
    palette=None,  # legend_kws=dict(bbox_to_anchor=(0.1,0.9),ncol=2),
    axis_format="tiny",
    figsize=(4, 3.5),  # rectangle_marker=True
    show_legend=True,
)

# Basic usage: color by Subclass with outline (for selected cell types only)
palette = (
    adata.obs.drop_duplicates("Subclass")
    .set_index("Subclass")["color_hex_subclass"]
    .to_dict()
)
ax = av.pl.plot_categorical(
    adata=adata_path,
    basis="umap",
    groupby="Subclass",
    coding=False,
    text_anno=None,
    outline=adata.obs.Subclass.apply(
        lambda x: x
        if x
        in [
            "STR D1 MSN",
            "STR D2 MSN",
            "STR Hybrid MSN",
            "Astrocyte",
            "Oligodendrocyte",
        ]
        else None
    ),
    outline_kws={
        "linewidth": 1,
        "palette": palette,
        "linestyles": "densely dashed",
        "single_contour_pad": 1,
        "threshold": 0.04,
        "smooth_sigma": 5,
    },
    palette=palette,  # legend_kws=dict(bbox_to_anchor=(0.1,0.9),ncol=2),
    axis_format="tiny",
    figsize=(4, 3.5),  # rectangle_marker=True
    show_legend=True,
)

2. plot_gene – Gene Expression on UMAP + Violin Plot¶

Plot a single gene’s expression on the UMAP embedding. When groupby is provided, a violin plot is also generated.

av.pl.plot_gene(
    adata=adata_path, gene="GAD2", basis="umap", cmap="RdBu_r", save="test.pdf"
)

3. stacked_barplot – Cell Type Composition¶

Show the proportion of cell types (e.g. Class) within each anatomical region or donor.

[8]:

# Load obs for barplot/pieplot (these accept a DataFrame directly)
adata = anndata.read_h5ad(os.path.expanduser(adata_path), backed="r")
obs = adata.obs.copy()
adata.file.close()

# Build color palettes from the existing color columns in obs
color_palettes = {}
for level in ["neighborhood", "class", "subclass", "group"]:
    col_name = level.capitalize() if level != "neighborhood" else "Neighborhood"
    hex_col = f"color_hex_{level}"
    if hex_col in obs.columns:
        color_palettes[col_name] = (
            obs.drop_duplicates(col_name).set_index(col_name)[hex_col].to_dict()
        )

print("Available color palettes:", list(color_palettes.keys()))

Available color palettes: ['Neighborhood', 'Class', 'Subclass', 'Group']

[9]:

# Stacked bar plot: Class composition per donor
ax = av.pl.bar_plot(
    adata=obs,
    groupby="Class",
    split_by="donor_id",
    palette=color_palettes.get("Class"),
    figsize=(5, 3.5),
    show=True,
    legend_kws=dict(frameon=True),
)

[10]:

# Stacked bar plot: Subclass composition per anatomical region
ax = av.pl.bar_plot(
    adata=obs,
    groupby="Subclass",
    split_by="anatomical_region_merged",
    palette=color_palettes.get("Subclass"),
    figsize=(5, 6),
    show=True,
)

Cell statistics plots¶

A family of categorical-composition plots (rose / ring / pie / area / dot / trend / sankey / chord / venn / upset) implemented on top of matplotlib, with a few optional extras (matplotlib-venn, upsetplot, pycirclize, adjustText).

All functions accept either an :class:anndata.AnnData (recommended: palettes are auto-loaded from adata.uns) or a :class:pandas.DataFrame / path to a tabular file. Each function with a legend exposes a legend_kws argument that is forwarded to matplotlib.

[14]:

import os
import warnings

import anndata
import pandas as pd

import adataviz as av

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)

adata_path = os.path.expanduser(
    "~/Projects/BICAN/adata/HMBA_v2/HMBA.Group.downsample_1500.h5ad"
)

# Load the full AnnData so colour palettes stored in ``adata.uns``
# (e.g. ``Class_colors``, ``Group_colors``) are picked up automatically.
adata = anndata.read_h5ad(adata_path)
print("adata:", adata.shape)
print(
    "Class:",
    adata.obs["Class"].nunique(),
    "| Subclass:",
    adata.obs["Subclass"].nunique(),
    "| Group:",
    adata.obs["Group"].nunique(),
)

adata: (70134, 36601)

9. venn_plot – shared expressed genes across three Subclasses¶

Pick three GABAergic Subclasses and ask which highly-expressed genes (>50% cells passing a CPM threshold) each Subclass has. Overlap is expected because they share neurotransmitter machinery.

[25]:

import scipy.sparse as _sp
import numpy as _np

sub_names = ["STR D1 MSN", "STR D2 MSN", "STR Hybrid MSN"]
gene_sets = {}
expressed_long = []
for sc in sub_names:
    sub = adata[adata.obs["Subclass"] == sc]
    if sub.shape[0] == 0:
        continue
    X = sub.X
    if _sp.issparse(X):
        frac = _np.asarray((X > 0).mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    else:
        frac = (X > 0).mean(axis=0)
    genes = sub.var_names[frac >= 0.2].tolist()
    gene_sets[sc] = genes
    expressed_long.extend([(sc, g) for g in genes])
venn_df = pd.DataFrame(expressed_long, columns=["Subclass", "gene"])
print({k: len(v) for k, v in gene_sets.items()})
av.pl.venn_plot(
    venn_df,
    groupby="Subclass",
    set_by="gene",
    figsize=(5, 5),
    title="Genes detected in >=20% of cells (per Subclass)",
)
plt.show()

{'STR D1 MSN': 10094, 'STR D2 MSN': 9584, 'STR Hybrid MSN': 9022}

10. upset_plot – expressed-gene overlap across five Classes¶

Compute the set of genes detected in >=20% of cells for each Class, then visualise their overlap. Upset is far more legible than Venn for >=4 sets.

[26]:

import numpy as _np

# Per-Class set of genes detected in >=20% of cells (sparse-aware).
import scipy.sparse as _sp

top_classes = adata.obs["Class"].value_counts().head(5).index.tolist()
rows = []
for cls in top_classes:
    sub = adata[adata.obs["Class"] == cls]
    X = sub.X
    if _sp.issparse(X):
        frac = _np.asarray((X > 0).mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    else:
        frac = (X > 0).mean(axis=0)
    genes = sub.var_names[frac >= 0.2].tolist()
    rows.extend([(cls, g) for g in genes])
upset_df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["Class", "gene"])
av.pl.upset_plot(
    upset_df,
    groupby="Class",
    set_by="gene",
    figsize=(9, 4.5),
    title="Genes detected in >=20% of cells per Class",
)
plt.show()

11. complex_heatmap – annotated marker heatmap with clustering¶

A 30+ marker panel covering glutamatergic, GABAergic, dopaminergic and glial Subclasses. Rows are clustered by z-score similarity and an extra row stripe shows the dominant Class per Subclass.

[27]:

# Curated panel covering glutamatergic, GABAergic, dopaminergic and glial markers.
panel = [
    "SLC17A7",
    "SLC17A6",
    "SATB2",
    "NEUROD2",  # Glut
    "GAD1",
    "GAD2",
    "SLC32A1",
    "PVALB",
    "SST",
    "VIP",
    "LAMP5",  # GABA-IN
    "DRD1",
    "DRD2",
    "PPP1R1B",
    "TAC1",
    "PENK",  # MSN
    "TH",
    "SLC6A3",
    "SLC18A2",
    "NR4A2",  # Dopa
    "CHAT",
    "SLC18A3",  # Cholinergic
    "AQP4",
    "GFAP",
    "SLC1A2",  # Astro
    "PDGFRA",
    "OLIG1",  # OPC
    "MOG",
    "MBP",
    "PLP1",  # Oligo
    "CX3CR1",
    "P2RY12",  # Microglia
    "CLDN5",
    "PECAM1",  # Vascular
]
panel = [g for g in panel if g in adata.var_names]
top_subclasses = adata.obs["Subclass"].value_counts().head(20).index.tolist()
sub = adata[adata.obs["Subclass"].isin(top_subclasses)].copy()
av.pl.complex_heatmap(
    sub,
    genes=panel,
    groupby="Subclass",
    z_score="row",
    cmap="RdBu_r",
    annotate=["Class"],
    row_cluster=True,
    col_cluster=True,
    figsize=(8, 7.5),
    title="Marker z-score per Subclass (rows annotated by Class)",
    plot_kws=dict(
        xticklabels_kws=dict(labelrotation=-45, labelsize=8, bottom=True),
        yticklabels_kws=dict(labelsize=8, right=True),
    ),
)
plt.show()

12. complex_dotplot – annotated dot heatmap¶

Same gene panel but rendered as a dot plot (size = % expressing, colour = mean expression). Subclasses on rows, genes on columns.

[28]:

av.pl.complex_dotplot(
    sub,
    genes=panel,
    groupby="Subclass",
    expression_cutoff=0.1,
    cmap="Reds",
    annotate=["Class"],
    row_cluster=True,
    col_cluster=False,
    figsize=(9, 8),
    title="Marker dot heatmap per Subclass",
    plot_kws=dict(
        xticklabels_kws=dict(labelrotation=-45, labelsize=8, bottom=True),
        yticklabels_kws=dict(labelsize=8, right=True),
    ),
)
plt.show()
